emulator_validation.fec: Format-5 parity matches four captured startup vectors and five-pair ordered UDP conformance; an independent polynomial oracle rejects corrupt parity. The Roku mobile app 14.1.2 played the alternating tone with format-5 parity enabled; turning Headphone Mode off removed the session. Receiver recovery under actual packet loss remains untested.

response_models.scope: Fields the Roku mobile app 14.1.2 decodes, by response model. Client requiredness is a decoder expectation only, not television requiredness. Whether the app reads a field and whether a device offers it still need per-feature checks. XML element lists keep their entry and inline settings; names are not flattened into invented paths.
